title: 60-Inch Extended 3-Post Grab Bar (Ada Compliant) | Sea Foam Green | Pipeline Grab Bars | Allied Brass
body_html:
Make the bathroom safer and easier to navigate with an extended-length grab bar that provides steady support for daily routines in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinate your space — part of the Pipeline grab bars collection for a consistent look across the bath.
  • Designed for versatile bathrooms — complements transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Finish options for your décor — available in multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Details

  • Product type: Extended 3-post bathroom grab bar
  • ADA Compliant
  • Overall dimensions: 63 in. L x 3 in. H x 3.58 in. W (60-inch grab bar)
  • Box dimensions: 64 in. x 6 in. x 8 in.
  • Shipping weight: 6 lbs
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
